blurb: Guests cruise through Naples Bay, Port Royal canals, and out Gordon Pass into the Gulf of Mexico to see waterfront homes, wildlife, and sunsets. Cruises include narration by the captain and tropical music. The yacht is a 105-foot luxury vessel with climate-controlled salons and full service bars.
